snippet.title: Asylum denied game trailer
snippet.description:
https://dimosadonis.itch.io/asylum-denied

Asylum denied is a horror survival game. The player has to escape the abandoned mansion that was once used as an asylum for WWI veterans. Will you make it out alive?
